reason: V0.14.3 runtime consumed standing MEXC authority from PROJECT_ROOT but the Windows PyInstaller build embedded only deployment_registry_v1.json. The initial artifact could therefore report standing authority missing/FAIL_CLOSED despite a valid operator authorization.
corrections: Package self-test now verifies standing authority presence, ID, ACTIVE status and scope.
Launcher requires exact V0.14.3.1 build identity before reusing an existing local node.
Add atomic IMPORT_MEXC_RECEIPTS_V0143.ps1 helper for sanitized preflight/risk receipts.
